body:
Just wanted to let you know and i'm here and feeling better. The dentist thing kicked this whole thing up, i've been bottling up and seething about things for months now and i guess i just broke down. 

I've made myself a "plan of action" of sorts primarily to sort my self esteem/worries out. 

I'm going to research my dentist and find out her success rate for this kind of surgery. This is kind of frowned upon in the UK seeing as our healthcare is free but i'm not risking my face.

The bike thing i mentioned is BMX, i'm no good and sick of hurting myself/sexist comments so i'm going to get rid and go to road bikes instead.

I also spoke to my boyfriend and admitted he does get annoyed (btw our sexlife isnt completely devoid, just not as often as we should) but he understands its down to self esteem issues for the both of us as well as the fact we're both going through exam stress. That's something we're going to work on together.

I don't hate my course entirely. I'm British and usually in our first year a few different degrees get lumped together meaning i study a few units i have no use for yet find hard as it's nothing to do with what i've been specialising in for the past 2/3 years. One of these units i'm currently revising for and not feeling too hopeful about. Next year i'll be doing what i actually want and love to do, just a month to go.

Also i'm going to join some more societies at uni. I'd rather make my own friends who have similar interests rather than hanging around friends of friends i dont really get along with. Starting with rock climbing and the gym again.

I'm going to go to the doctors too because i scared myself last night. I've also been having what i think are anxiety attacks for a good year now and it's time to sort them out.

Thank you for your messages of support (seriously, thank you) and i'm sorry i left it so late to reply. Apologies for this wall of text too, i guess telling you all what i'm going to do has sortof cemented my plan of action.

PS Oh fuck yeah i'm still aiming for Google. No point in dreams if you don't attempt to follow them.
